ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels across the primary surface with 15% high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and in circular focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous banding is localized along the trailing edges of both lobes. Significant white focal clusters are present near the median notch on the left lobe. Numerous circular white ring patterns are distributed across the low-intensity dark body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 40-degree interior angle relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude; most prominent peaks are located on the medial-to-mid sections of both lobes' trailing boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that exhibit a distinct upward and outward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) across the central dark field. High-contrast, textured 3D protrusions (barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment; massive barnacle clusters present on the outer margins of both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct irregular white patch of high pixel intensity located on the trailing edge of the left lobe proximal to the median notch.
